reference.method: Native Run All and request-gutter execution in an owned project, with independent Go loopback server events

expectationAuthority: Expected names, resolved URIs and variable-error categories were written from the observed reference behavior and owned fixtures; they were not generated by HttpRequestDocument or the reconstruction. Names exclude the native Services filename prefix.
scope: Parser planning only. A parsable URI can still fail at transport time; HTTP statuses and cancellation are separate runtime observations.
